aiAudit.summary:
Summary (concise): the repo is in good shape (9.1/10 internal score) but has a few concrete architecture and ownership issues and several missing env/config docs. Below are focused observations and action-oriented recommendations you can triage by priority.

1) Top architecture risks
- Missing/undocumented runtime secrets (security): nine process.env keys referenced but not in .env.example (PK-QUALITY-051). Risk: deploys break or secrets leak via implicit assumptions.
  - Files/keys called out: DISCOVERY_PLAYWRIGHT, JSON2VIDEO_API_KEY, MM_IMAGE_API_KEY, MM_IMAGE_MODEL, MM_IMAGE_PROVIDER, MM_IMAGE_RENDER, MM_VOICE_MODEL, MM_VOICE_PROVIDER, OPENAI_CONTENT_BRAIN_MODEL.
  - Recommendation: immediately add these to .env.example (with safe placeholders), mark which are required in production, and add CI gating that fails if referenced env vars are undocumented.
- Cross-feature deep-import (coupling): brand UI deep-imports dashboard internals (PK-QUALITY-063: src/components/brand/brand-approved.tsx → @/components/dashboard/dashboard-home/phase-query). Risk: brittle coupling, harder to refactor, ownership conflicts.
  - Recommendation: extract the required API into a dashboard public entry (index.ts) or move shared logic to a domain/shared module and replace the deep import with the public API.
- Mixed-layer route file (separation-of-concerns): src/app/api/onboarding/workspace-context/route.ts mixes db, server, next, engine logic (PK-QUALITY-061). Risk: testing and security surface g
